svg.aria-label: ShopVerse CI/CD, GitOps promotion and Terraform pipeline
svg.title: ShopVerse CI/CD, GitOps promotion and Terraform pipeline
svg.text: ShopVerse delivery — CI (Jenkins), GitOps CD (ArgoCD), promotion and infrastructure (GitHub Actions)
1 · Application build (Jenkins on EC2 · instance role, per changed service, in parallel) → deploy to dev (ArgoCD)
Any red security stage stops the pipeline: nothing unscanned or unsigned can reach ECR.
2 · Environment promotion by image tag (same Helm chart, different values)
Rollback = git revert of the tag commit (ArgoCD re-syncs) or kubectl argo rollouts abort/undo. Same artifact moves dev → staging → prod; it is never rebuilt.
3 · Infrastructure (Terraform via GitHub Actions + AWS OIDC — no stored keys)
20:00 IST: terraform destroy dev EKS + compute
08:00 IST: terraform apply dev, ArgoCD restores apps from Git
EKS control plane costs ~$0.10/hr, so dev only runs in working hours
GitHub mints a short-lived token per run
AWS IAM trusts only repo OWNER/shopverse on main / PRs
plan role is read-only; apply role is gated by environments
k6 smoke on every deploy · k6 load before prod release
Grafana SLO dashboard + Alertmanager burn-rate alerts
